message: The scope of the anonymous method or lambda expression with a block body cannot be determined. Use 'meta.RunTime' or 'meta.CompileTime' to resolve the ambiguity.
title: The scope of an anonymous method or lambda expression with a block body cannot be determined.
rationale: The title repeats the whole message, including the advice, instead of being one short sentence. 'Lambda block' is imprecise: the report site (TemplateAnnotator.VisitAnonymousFunctionExpression) fires only for lambda expressions with a block body, because expression-bodied lambdas take the scope of their expression.
